text_block_list.text: Another school day begins for the Umamusume. With the chime of the preliminary bell, the teacher enters the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, good morning.
Let's get right to it, then...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch, munch*...
*Munch, munch, munch*... *gulp*!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Special Week, please don't eat
right up until class starts.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, you overslept
and missed breakfast, didn't you, YES?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It wasn't until last night
that I remembered I hadn't done my homework...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...El-chan?
What's wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, it seemed like you went to bed early last night...
Did you do it? Your homework, I mean."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gah!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
“...Class monitors, please collect the homework during lunch break
and bring it to the staff room.
Make sure you have it done by then.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Honestly, good grief. You really dodged a bullet there.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san and El-san are both hopeless, honestly.
You should follow King's example!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This homework, finished to absolute perfection...
Well? Given your current situation,
don't you want it so badly you could scream?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Man, that's our King~ Amazing, amazing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Is that what you got for question 3?
That's different from mine...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's impossible!
I double-checked it so many times... Look closer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...From the top: x = 3√7, 36, √2... and so on.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wait, didn't you just memorize the whole answer?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: King, lemme see too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, me too!
Honestly, I didn't feel like I had it right at all...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Heeey?

text_block_list.name: Spe & El
text_block_list.text: Gulp...!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, so as a review, we'll also be going over the homework material, so make sure everyone clearly writes down their own answers!

"It seems they continue to battle each other
even off the racetrack..."
